author: Soumyatifr
body:
### Summary
This PR removes the obsolete DeepCSV-based b-tagging configuration from the Phase-2 `HLT_75e33` menu.

The changes include:
- Removal of DeepCSV-specific filters and inference modules.
- Removal of DeepCSV sequences and the associated HLT path.
- Removal of DeepCSV references from `MC_BTV` and `DST_PFScouting`.
- Cleanup of the corresponding references in `HLT_75e33_cff.py`.

The DeepFlavour-based b-tagging paths and their shared reconstruction components are preserved.

### Validation
- Python configuration compilation passed.
- `git diff HEAD --check` passed before committing.
- Zero-event `cmsRun` configuration test completed successfully.
- The updated trigger report contains no DeepCSV paths, while the DeepFlavour paths remain present.

Event-level validation has not yet been performed.
title: Remove DeepCSV from Phase-2 HLT menu
